units: <cite ref="Ketubot 27a:12">Keth. 27ᵃ</cite> <he>אם יש שם מחבואה אחת</he> if there was only one hiding place (where the troops did not enter); <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 3:4:2">Y. Gitt. III, 45ᵃ</cite> top <he>היה שם מחבויה</he> (read <he>היתה</he>).—Pl. <he>מַחֲבוֹאִים</he>, <he>מַחֲבוֹיִים</he>, <he>מַחֲבוֹיִין</he> (b. h. <he>מַחֲבֹאִים</he>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 2:9:4">Y. Keth. II, 26ᵈ</cite> <he>היו שם מ׳</he>, v. supra.—
<cite ref="Menachot 63a:3">Men. 63ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="M00805"><he>מַחֲבַת</he></cite>) <he>דאתיא אמַחֲבוֹאֵי הלב</he> it atones for the hidden (sinful) thoughts of the heart.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 7:2:6">Y. Peah VII, 20ᵃ</cite> bot. (expl. <he>כרכר</he> a. <he>כרכרה</he> as a substitute for <cite ref="M00795"><he>מַחֲבֵא</he> II</cite>) <he>שהוא משיר את המ׳</he> (not <he>משייר</he>) for it (the rod) causes the hidden olives to fall off.
